verdict.rationale: Codex is explicitly a delegated coding agent that can be handed longer tasks from web, CLI, or IDE and works autonomously in cloud/local sandboxes, producing diffs, PRs, and follow-ups—directly matching the delegation story. Community evidence confirms real-world heavy use as an agentic delegate (e.g., 'used codex much more heavily... no worse than average L3-L4 engs'), though with caveats on speed, quota limits, and inconsistent quality.
